description.zh: Adjust the frosted-glass background. Opacity and transparency are exact complements: opacity + transparency = 100. Opacity 100 is fully opaque; opacity 0 is fully transparent. Transparency 100 is fully transparent; transparency 0 is fully opaque. For relative wording such as 'more transparent', use mode='more_transparent'; for 'more opaque', use mode='less_transparent'.
description.en: Adjust the frosted-glass background. Opacity and transparency are exact complements: opacity + transparency = 100. Opacity 100 is fully opaque; opacity 0 is fully transparent. Transparency 100 is fully transparent; transparency 0 is fully opaque. For relative wording such as 'more transparent', use mode='more_transparent'; for 'more opaque', use mode='less_transparent'.

mode.description: Use set for an explicit opacity or transparency percentage.

transparency.description: Only for mode=set. 0 is fully opaque; 100 is fully transparent.

opacity.description: Only for mode=set. 0 is fully transparent; 100 is fully opaque.

amount.description: Relative adjustment size, default 15 percentage points.
